issues.message: Variant is a near-faithful reproduction of the source; composition, palette, and block placement all match closely.
Disclaimer text at the bottom is very small (~7-8px effective) and slightly low contrast against the dark navy background, though this is consistent with the source treatment.
CTA pill sits close to the right edge (~12px padding); within tolerance but on the tighter side of the ≥16px guideline.

notes: High-fidelity variant of the source. Hierarchy (headline → CTA → supporting copy → disclaimer) is preserved, brand palette and wordmark treatment match, and the CTA pill is clearly legible. Only minor cosmetic notes.
